name: governance-records
description: File the records of human decisions in Noru: minutes, ISMS scope, statement of applicability, internal audit plans and reports, findings and corrective action plans, each attributed and dated.

interface.shortDescription: Turn minutes and governance documents into attributed evidence.
interface.longDescription: Asks Noru which catalogue expectations are unmet, reads the governance documents already in your repository — minutes, ISMS scope, statement of applicability, audit plans and reports, findings, corrective action plans — extracts who met, what was decided and what was assigned to whom with a citation for every fact, and files each record as attributed evidence over MCP.
capabilities: Local read: minutes and governance documents
Local write: .noru/governance-records.yml and machine-only cache files
Noru read: controls and unmet evidence expectations
Noru write: attributed evidence only after diff and confirmation
Unmet governance expectations from Noru's own catalogue
Structured extraction from minutes and governance documents
Named participants, decisions and owned actions
Attributed records with a review date
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me which governance expectations are unmet and which of my minutes could satisfy them. Do not push or write to Noru.
